name: Biomedical Research Communication
description: The course focuses on academic writing as it applies to research communication at the doctoral level. Areas covered include how academic and research texts are organized and argued, achieving precision and economy in expression, while avoiding frequent compositional pitfalls. The course is structured around active participation; students will engage in frequent guided writing tasks with written assignments designed to progressively build their capacity for independent scholarly output.
